Title: Azure Cosmos DB: New quick-start apps in the Azure portal

Body.Content:
Azure Cosmos DB now has quick-start apps available in the Azure portal. After you’ve created a Azure Cosmos DB account, click Quick start on the resource menu. In seconds, you can create a personalized, ready-to-run NoSQL database sample app that’s connected to your newly created Azure Cosmos DB account. Samples are available in .NET, Java, Node.js, and Python.

Step 1 of each sample creates an empty “Items” collection in your account. Step 2 generates a personalized solution file with your connection string information. So all you need to do is build the app and add items to your new to-do list built on Azure Cosmos DB.
